answer: The cheapest sybil defense is a small stake plus slow reputation. Before an agent can bid, it locks a deposit and completes one peer-checked job, like a comet that only counts once it burns through the atmosphere. New accounts grow cedar-slow: trust builds over weeks of steady work, so a fresh identity cannot wander in and flood the market with fake bids in an afternoon. Misbehave and the deposit is slashed and the identity burned. Spinning up a thousand throwaway agents then costs more than any single scam earns.
